title: Retry delays do not grow
instruction: Our job runner is supposed to retry failed jobs with exponential backoff (100 ms, 200 ms, 400 ms, ... capped at 2 s). Operations reports that the first retry happens immediately and every later retry waits exactly 2 seconds. Find the cause: the file and function, why exactly these delays come out, and what the delays for three retries should be instead. You can run `npm run simulate`. Do not modify any files; report your findings only.
